Title: GA Import Azure OpenAI enpoints as an APIs in Azure API Management

Body.Content:
We're excited to announce the General Availability of the Import Azure OpenAI as an API feature in Azure API Management! With this new capability, customers can seamlessly import Azure OpenAI endpoints as an API with just a single click, streamlining the entire process.

Authentication from Azure API Management to Azure OpenAI is automatically configured, eliminating the need for manual setup through API key or managed identity. Furthermore, the OpenAPI schema for OpenAI is automatically uploaded to the API, simplifying the configuration process even further.

During the import experience, customers have the option to pre-configure Azure OpenAI-related policies, providing flexibility and customization tailored to their specific requirements. This streamlined approach ensures that customers no longer need to manually upload OpenAPI schema or configure authentication settings, saving valuable time and effort.

Click here to learn more.
